# Toolbox

> Sanna Granqvist's small, free, open-source tools for design work: web apps, Framer plugins and Claude Code skills. No accounts.

## Tools

- [AEO Scanner](https://granqvistsanna-web.github.io/aeo-scanner/): checks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini can find, read and quote a page
- [Performance Checker](https://granqvistsanna-web.github.io/perf-checker/): runs Lighthouse on a URL and explains the scores, Core Web Vitals, real-user data and the fixes worth doing first
- [Button Lab](https://granqvistsanna-web.github.io/button-hover-lab/): button hover animations, built and ready to port to Framer
- [Colourbook](https://granqvistsanna-web.github.io/colorbook/): a palette library
- [Video Compressor](https://granqvistsanna-web.github.io/video-compressor/): shrinks video loops for the web in the browser, nothing uploaded
- [WebP Converter](https://granqvistsanna-web.github.io/image-compressor/): converts images to WebP in the browser
- [Rate & Pricing Calculator](https://granqvistsanna-web.github.io/pricing/): works out rates and project prices
- [frameshotter](https://granqvistsanna-web.github.io/frameshot/): a local CLI for retina screenshots of Framer sites

## Design system

- [Pumice](https://granqvistsanna-web.github.io/pumice/): the soft, warm-grey design system every tool page uses
